ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point \(O\) is a point inside \(\triangle ABC\), \(\angle ABO=30^\circ\), \(\angle ACO=15^\circ\), \(\angle BOC=100^\circ\), then what is the degree measure of \(\angle A\)?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since, in $\triangle OBC$, $\angle BOC=100^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle OBC+\angle OCB=180^\circ-\angle BOC=80^\circ$,\\
In $\triangle ABC$,\\
$\angle A=180^\circ-(\angle ABO+\angle ACO+\angle OBC+\angle OCB)=180^\circ-(30^\circ+15^\circ+80^\circ)=\boxed{55^\circ}$.
